meta.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a non-Tenant Admin and verify that RBAC permission assignment is refused or unavailable, then repeat as a Tenant Admin and verify that it is available in the same tenant
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a non-Tenant Admin and verify that RBAC permission assignment is refused or unavailable, then repeat as a Tenant Admin and verify that it is available in the same tenant

args.need: sign in as the non-Tenant Admin and Tenant Admin users in the same tenant, open RBAC, attempt to assign permissions by role as each user, and record whether the action is refused or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot access the RBAC screen, switch between these roles, or perform the permission-assignment comparison.
Assert that the resulting screen remains free of crashes or server errors after the tester's RBAC comparison.
